claims: South Africa and Panama played to a 1-1 draw.
The match was an international friendly.
The match was at Moses Mabhida Stadium in Durban.
Yoel Bárcenas scored for Panama in the 23rd minute.
Oswin Appollis equalized for Bafana Bafana in the 48th minute.
The match between South Africa and Panama on March 27, 2026 is part of two friendlies held in South Africa.
